title: Privacy Policy
body:
Sloane Street Auctions ("we", "us") is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use www.sloanestreetauctions.com or deal with us, how we use it, who we share it with and the rights you have. Please read it together with our [Conditions of Sale](/terms-and-conditions).

For the purposes of UK data protection law (the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018), the data controller is Sloane Street Auctions of 158–164 Fulham Road, London SW10 9PR.

## Information you give us

You may give us information about you by filling in forms on our website, or by corresponding with us by telephone, e-mail, in person or otherwise. This includes:

- Valuation requests: your name, e-mail address and telephone number, details of your item and any photographs you send.
- Jewellery valuation bookings: your name, e-mail address, telephone number and anything you choose to tell us about your jewellery (more detail below).
- Our mailing list: your e-mail address.
- Buying and selling with us: when you register to bid, buy or consign, we collect the details needed to do so, which may include your name, address, contact details, payment details, and proof of identity and address to comply with anti-money laundering and sanctions laws.

## Online registration and bidding

Online registration and bidding for our live auctions take place on the Easy Live Auction platform, and for our timed online sales on The Saleroom. When you register or bid there, the platform collects your details, including any card details, and shares with us what we need to run the sale. Card details are handled by the platform's payment processor, not by this website. Your use of those platforms is also covered by their own privacy policies.

## Jewellery valuation bookings

When you book a jewellery valuation on our site, we collect your name, e-mail address, telephone number and anything you choose to tell us about your jewellery. We use these details only to arrange, confirm and, if needed, change or cancel your valuation, and to contact you about it. Your booking is kept in our Google Calendar, and our booking e-mails are sent through our e-mail provider, Resend; both handle your details on our behalf. To stop misuse of the booking form, we also keep a short-lived record of the internet address a booking was sent from, which is deleted automatically within a day. You can ask us to change or delete your booking details at any time by contacting us at accounts@sloanestreetauctions.com.

## Our mailing list

If you join our mailing list, your e-mail address is held by our mailing list provider, Mailchimp, on our behalf. We first send you an e-mail asking you to confirm, and only add you once you have. We e-mail you only about our sales and news, and every e-mail has a link to unsubscribe at any time.

## Cookies and visitor statistics

Our website does not use advertising or tracking cookies, and does not set cookies when you browse it.

We count visits to our pages using Vercel Web Analytics, which works without cookies and does not store information that identifies you. It tells us, for example, how many people looked at a page, so we can improve the site.

The map on our Contact page is provided by Google and only loads if you choose to show it. Google may then set its own cookies, as described in Google's privacy policy.

## How we use your information

We use your information:

- to provide the valuations, bookings, auctions and other services you ask for, and to carry out any contract between you and us;
- to reply to your enquiries and keep you informed about your items, purchases and payments;
- to send you news of our sales if you have joined our mailing list;
- to comply with our legal obligations, including anti-money laundering checks, tax and accounting records;
- to keep our website and services safe, secure and working properly, and to prevent fraud and misuse.

We rely on the following legal grounds: performing a contract with you or taking steps at your request before entering into one; our legitimate interests in running and improving our business; your consent, for our mailing list; and compliance with the law.

## Who we share your information with

We share your information only where needed, with:

- service providers who help us run our website and business, such as our website host (Vercel), our e-mail provider (Resend), Google (for our calendar) and Mailchimp (for our mailing list), who process it only on our instructions;
- the Easy Live Auction and The Saleroom platforms, where you register or bid through them;
- buyers or sellers, carriers and other parties, where needed to complete a sale or delivery you have asked for;
- our professional advisers, and credit reference or identity verification agencies where this is needed to assess a transaction or comply with the law.

We may also disclose your information:

- if we sell or buy any business or assets, to the prospective buyer or seller of that business or those assets;
- if we are under a duty to disclose or share it to comply with a legal obligation, to enforce our Conditions of Sale and other agreements, or to protect the rights, property or safety of Sloane Street Auctions, our clients or others, including exchanging information with other organisations for fraud prevention.

We do not sell your personal information.

## Where we store your information

Some of our service providers store or process information outside the United Kingdom. Where this happens, we take steps to make sure your information is protected as UK data protection law requires.

The transmission of information via the internet is never completely secure. Although we do our best to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee the security of data sent to our website; once we have received it, we use appropriate procedures and security measures to prevent unauthorised access.

## How long we keep your information

We keep personal information only for as long as we need it for the purposes above, including to meet our legal, accounting and record-keeping obligations (for example, anti-money laundering records). Then it is deleted or anonymised.

## Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to:

- ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you;
- ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete;
- ask us to delete your information, or to restrict how we use it;
- object to our use of your information, including for marketing;
- ask us to transfer your information to another organisation;
- withdraw your consent at any time, where we rely on it (for example, by unsubscribing from our mailing list).

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at accounts@sloanestreetauctions.com.

## Other websites

Our website links to other websites, including Easy Live Auction, The Saleroom, Google Maps and Instagram. They have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for them. Please check their policies before you give them any personal data.

## Changes to this policy

Any changes we make to this policy will be posted on this page and, where appropriate, notified to you by e-mail.

## Data protection complaints

If you have a complaint about how Sloane Street Auctions collects, uses, stores or otherwise handles your personal information, please contact us first so that we can investigate and respond.

You can make a data protection complaint by contacting us using the details below:

Email: accounts@sloanestreetauctions.com

Post: Sloane Street Auctions, 158–164 Fulham Road, London SW10 9PR

To help us deal with your complaint, please include your name, contact details, a clear description of your complaint, and any relevant dates, correspondence or reference details.

We will acknowledge receipt of your complaint within 30 days. We will then review the matter, make appropriate enquiries and keep you informed while we investigate. Once we have completed our review, we will tell you the outcome without undue delay.

If you are unhappy with how we have handled your complaint, you also have the right to raise your concern with the Information Commissioner's Office, the UK regulator for data protection matters. Further information is available at www.ico.org.uk.

## Contact

Questions, comments and requests regarding this privacy policy are welcome and should be addressed to accounts@sloanestreetauctions.com.
